limitations: No installed agy 1.5.17 was found. Built-in docs are shared installation files and carry no version attestation. Embedded tools can be account-gated; no authenticated execution was attempted.
The built-in rules guide documents .agents/rules, not .antigravity/rules. AIWG retains and audits its existing .antigravity/rules output through its bootstrap; no native loader claim is made.

Core-tool source markers and protobuf fields establish shipped implementations/schema types, not the account-visible tool roster. In particular the read_file/write_file projection has not been exercised as a provider tool call.

action.description: What to do: status, models, add, model, kill or title.

name.description: Roster name of the worker, for add, model and kill (or base name when n > 1 or tasks is set). Short, lowercase, no spaces.

n.description: Optional number of homogeneous copies to spawn (<name>-1 through <name>-<n>), for add when the user explicitly asks for multiple agents sharing one role and brief. Omit (defaults to 1) to spawn a single named worker.

model.description: Model to pin this worker to, for add and model: a model name listed by the models action. Leave it unset to use your own model, unless the user asks for another.

all.description: For models: list every model add accepts, not just the suggested ones.

brief.description: The worker's assignment, for add: what it owns and what done looks like. Posted publicly on the board.

tasks.description: Optional per-worker slice targets for add when spawning a sharded group (<name>-1 through <name>-<len(tasks)>), each combined with the shared brief. Omit for normal single-worker add calls.

workspace.description: Where each worker works, for add. inherit (default) is your own workspace. share gives each worker its own working copy of your repository; branch gives each an isolated clone. kill deletes a share or branch workspace.

title.description: A short title for the swarm, for the UI.

backend.description: Where the board is stored: auto (default), spanner, or local files. Honoured only on the call that creates the swarm; leave it unset unless the user asks.

documentedSurfaces.schedule: builtin schedule sidecar with cron expression
documentedSurfaces.reload: new plugin directories discovered on startup

embeddedChangelogExcerpts: - Fixed `define_subagent` using a model-supplied agent name directly as a directory name, so a name containing `..` could write its `agent.md` outside the conversation's artifact directory; names are now validated at both the tool and the handler.
